theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: Famous Brazil Judge Yanked From ‘Fake News’ Probe That Made Him
top_news.summary: Brazil’s chief justice removed the Supreme Court’s most prominent judge from a sprawling, seven-year probe into “fake news,” seeking to tame an institutional crisis that has spilled over into October’s presidential election.

top_news.title: Port of LA Hits Three-Month Record as Cargo Peak Stretches On
top_news.summary: The Port of Los Angeles just completed its busiest three-month run on record, as the early peak season stretched through August and importers navigated changing tariff policies and extreme weather across the globe.

top_news.title: Citadel Securities Urges SEC to Take Oversight of Some Wagers
top_news.summary: Citadel Securities told regulators that prediction market contracts linked to publicly-traded companies should be overseen by the Securities and Exchange Commission instead of the agency that has taken responsibility for them so far, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

top_news.title: Carney Woos Investors on Deals for Data Centers, Mines and LNG
top_news.summary: Canada plans to show some of the world’s biggest investors a pitchbook laying out tens of billions of dollars worth of projects spanning data centers, advanced manufacturing, liquefied natural gas, ports and dozens of mines.

top_news.title: Energy Transfer Switches Listing to Texas From NYSE, WSJ Says
top_news.summary: Pipeline giant Energy Transfer LP plans to move its primary listing to the Texas Stock Exchange from the New York Stock Exchange, according to the Wall Street Journal, a major win for the upstart marketplace as it seeks to upend the listing business.

top_news.title: Bessent’s Upsized Buybacks Get Hit by Bond Market Reality
top_news.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s unusual move to supersize his department’s debt buyback program stumbled on Wednesday, when an announcement on the size of the first enlarged operation proved insufficient to halt market declines.

top_news.title: Reflecting on 25 Years Since 9/11 Attacks
top_news.summary: Mark Jacobson, International Spy Museum Historian and retired US Navy Intelligence Officer, shares his experience being inside the Pentagon on September 11, 2001. He recalls being near the point of impact, and the difficulties in getting in touch with his family to let them know he had survived. top_news.title: Mexican Government Slashes Pemex Aid by 70% in New Budget
top_news.summary: Mexico plans to cut financial support for state-owned Petroleos Mexicanos by nearly 70% next year, earmarking 81 billion pesos ($4.8 billion) to help cover the oil producer’s debt payments.

top_news.title: Houston, London Challenged by Volatile Brazil Power Market on Trader Pay
top_news.summary: Commodity powerhouses Trafigura and Macquarie are seeking to profit from a surge in price volatility.

top_news.title: Australian Property Stocks Vulnerable Following Bathla Collapse
top_news.summary: Australia’s property stocks are trailing global peers by the most in 16 years, and analysts worry it may get worse as the prospect of more rate hikes and the unraveling of a suburban developer intensify scrutiny in the sector.
